Class TUIDrawer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.view.TUI.TUIDrawer
public class TUIDrawer extends Object
Terminal renderer for Mesos. Uses 256-color ANSI (\033[38;5;Nm) + Unicode box-drawing/icons. Targets Windows Terminal, PowerShell 7+, iTerm2, modern Linux. Legacy cmd.exe is not supported.

Adjacent-SGR rule: some Windows consoles drop the first of two adjacent escape sequences ("\033[31m\033[1m" can render as "[31m"). The convention here is one of:

  1. Combine attributes into a single SGR ("\033[1;31m").
  2. Wrap a single visual chunk in one ansi(String, String) call; insert at least one printable character between two such calls.
Width math uses stripAnsi(String) which only counts visible chars.
